caption: The drawing shows a long-sleeved, full-length dress rendered in shades of purple and blue. The dress features puffed sleeves at the shoulders and narrow, fitted cuffs at the wrists. The collar stands up around the neck and is decorated with small red and gold elements, matching the triangular red and gold decorative accents found on the chest, cuffs, and belt. The bodice is detailed with blue trim, which continues down the front opening and forms a swirling pattern at the bottom of the skirt. The dress is gathered at the waist by a belt of the same blue and purple material, also ornamented with red and gold. The fabric of the dress falls in soft, vertical folds from the waist to the hem, with extra folds accentuating the fullness at the shoulders, and there is detailed blue and gold patterning along the front panels and cuffs. The background is plain and cream-colored, and there is no visible head, hands, or feet in the drawing.
title: Blue Afternoon Dress
